root_cause.text: The `svs_enable_debug_write()` function in the MediaTek SVS driver fails to free the memory allocated for `buf` via `memdup_user_nul()` when an early error return occurs due to a `kstrtoint()` failure.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds the `__free(kfree)` cleanup attribute to the `buf` variable declaration and removes the explicit `kfree(buf)` call at the end of `svs_enable_debug_write()`, ensuring the memory is freed on all exit paths.
